notes.title: Progress Update & Beta Testing Sign-Up
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

We aim to keep you updated on our progress by posting a devlog every two weeks.

Development is going smoothly, and we are on track to complete the project by October.

We are wrapping up the development of the first two game levels, which will be included in a demo for the beta testing session. This demo will also feature the garage section, where you can enhance your vehicle's stats by purchasing chips that modify your machine.
Various in-game power-ups will be available, including drones, special abilities, and different types of weapons.

We hope you enjoy it and look forward to your feedback. 
Sign up for beta testing here! 

We are putting significant effort into the new game graphics. Here you can see a comparison between some elements of the original game and the reloaded version.
